name: case-file
title: Case file
for_each: select c.id, c.code from cases c where c.status not in ('settled', 'withdrawn', 'closed') order by c.code

sections.title: Case
sections.sql: select c.code, m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name as member, m.member_no, w.name as workplace, e.name as employer, c.kind, c.jurisdiction, c.organiser, c.status, c.event_on, c.raised_on, c.determination_on, c.summary, c.next_step, c.next_step_due from cases c join members m on m.id = c.member_id left join workplaces w on w.id = m.workplace_id left join employers e on e.id = w.employer_id where c.id = $1

sections.title: Time limits
sections.note: Check against the rule before acting. Sources in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select d.rule, d.limit_text, d.deadline_on, d.days_left from case_deadlines d join cases c on c.code = d.code where c.id = $1

sections.title: Contact history
sections.sql: select k.contacted_on, k.kind, k.body, k.actor from contacts k join cases c on c.member_id = k.member_id where c.id = $1 order by k.contacted_on desc

name: employer-remittance-statement
title: Union fee remittance statement
for_each: select id, name from employers order by code

sections.title: Employer
sections.sql: select name, payroll_contact, payroll_email from employers where id = $1

sections.title: Remittances received
sections.sql: select code as remittance, period_start, period_end, received_on, amount_cents from remittances where employer_id = $1 order by period_end desc

sections.title: Members with authorised deductions missing from the latest remittance
sections.sql: select g.member_no, g.name, g.workplace from remittance_gaps g join employers e on e.code = g.employer where e.id = $1 order by g.name

name: bargaining-brief
title: Bargaining brief
for_each: select id, name from agreements where status <> 'superseded' order by code

sections.title: Agreement
sections.sql: select b.name, b.jurisdiction, b.starts_on, b.expires_on, b.days_to_expiry, b.window_opens_on, b.round, b.round_status, b.initiated_on, b.next_meeting_on, b.members_covered from bargaining_status b join agreements a on a.code = b.code where a.id = $1

sections.title: Claims
sections.sql: select r.code as round, r.status, r.claims from bargaining_rounds r where r.agreement_id = $1 order by r.created_at desc

sections.title: Coverage and density
sections.sql: select d.workplace, d.name, d.headcount, d.members, d.density_pct, d.delegates from density d join workplaces w on w.code = d.workplace join agreement_workplaces aw on aw.workplace_id = w.id where aw.agreement_id = $1 order by d.workplace
